description: Why: backpressure is the stated mechanism for protecting IPFS write throughput under load. What: IpfsLatencyMonitor is defined and wired in PeeringShared but never queried in the TAKETHIS/IHAVE ingestion path. Articles are enqueued regardless of IPFS write latency, so the monitor collects data nobody acts on. The flood_backpressure.rs tests only test queue-depth and byte limits, not latency-based backpressure. This means a slow IPFS node will saturate the pipeline without any 431 slow-down signal.
title: IpfsLatencyMonitor disconnected from pipeline
